The Future of Transport

The given article suggests a number of new modes of transport which
will change the way we move today. Read it carefully and identify the
type of transport you want to see in your country and why?
Like many other sectors, transportation is about to enter a
period of rapid change. Increasing urbanisation, rising
income in the developing world, and the advancement of
new technologies-as well as innovative combinations of
existing onesare among the many factors driving change
in how we commute to work and travel on holiday.
Another important factor leading to change is the climate.
With high levels of carbon dioxide in the air, researches are
being carried out on using smart and efficient technologies

The future transport systems are already designed. Big
automobile companies are all set to launch these future
transport systems. The United Arab Emirates is one of the
first countries switching to the future transport system. Five
different future transport systems are going to be available
in the near future i.e. flying taxis, hyper loops, sky pods
driverless cars, electric airplanes.
Flying taxis: The five-seat, all electric taxi will take off and
land vertically. These taxis are environment friendly, safe and
reliable. It is believed that these flying taxis are a perfect
solution to urban roads and traffic issues.
